GOOD QUESTIONS

A little clarity.

Before you take the next step.

What is Monero AutoPilot?+

AutoPilot is a Windows desktop wallet for sending, receiving, and managing Monero. Your keys stay on your device, and your wallets, payments, and connection controls are all in one place.

Do I need to install Tor separately?+

No. AutoPilot includes its own Tor client and starts it as part of the connection flow. There’s no separate Tor installation to manage.

Who holds my wallet keys?+

The desktop wallet keeps its keys on your device. The node server does not hold your recovery phrase or spending keys. Keep your recovery phrase private: anyone who has it can restore the wallet.

What does “AutoPilot” do automatically?+

It manages the wallet connection and retries permitted routes. Payments still require your review and PIN authorization. It does not automatically resend a payment when its outcome is uncertain.

Can I restore an existing wallet?+

Yes. Choose Restore wallet in the desktop app and enter your Monero recovery phrase there. Keep that phrase private and never enter it on a website.

Is this an official Monero project?+

Monero AutoPilot is an independent project built with Monero software. It is not an official Monero wallet or an endorsement by the Monero Project. Learn about Monero at getmonero.org ↗.

WEBSITE PRIVACY

Your privacy, here too.

This website uses no analytics scripts or advertising trackers. The interactive wallet tour runs in your browser and does not submit payments.

Your recovery phrase and payment PIN belong in the desktop app, never on this website. The hosting service may process ordinary access logs and access-control data.
